slides.headline: Nobody replies to "I hope this finds you well."

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: AI makes it easy to send 100 of these. Everyone can tell.
slides.right:
One real detail.
One clear offer.
slides.right_sub: Personal first line. Short. Easy to answer.

slides.label: Step 1
slides.title: Pick one client type
slides.card: Describe my ideal client in 3 lines: role, main problem, what they already tried.

slides.label: Step 2
slides.title: Find their pain
slides.card: List 5 problems this person complains about. Phrase each the way they would say it.

slides.label: Step 3
slides.title: Write the first line
slides.card: Here is their bio: [paste]. Write 3 first lines that mention one real detail. No flattery.

slides.label: Step 4
slides.title: Keep it short
slides.card: Write a 50-word message: first line, one problem, one offer, one easy question.
slides.note: Always edit it so it sounds like you.

slides.label: Step 5
slides.title: Plan the follow-up
slides.card: Write a short follow-up for 3 days later. Add one useful tip. No guilt trips.
slides.note: Only message people you can help. No spam.

slides.headline: Send this to a freelancer friend.

scenes.title: THE PROMPT
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: Read this document. Give me: the 5 key points, every deadline and number, what I must decide, and the risks. Add the page number for each. Ask me if anything is unclear.

scenes.title: What you get
scenes.footer: Page numbers let you check the source.

scenes.note: Not legal advice. Remove private details first.
scenes.text: Save this for your next long document.
